{{Dialogue|Kenobi|We believe a ''Jawa'' clan has been recovering the debris and selling it to Dooku&mdash;where his droids retrofit them to their ships and hit ours, hard.|Skywalker|So we go there and stop the Jawas from selling the parts. ''Undercover'' I will be.|attr=Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, Mace Windu and Yoda|src=<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] went on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in order to find proof that a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] clan had been selling weapons to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Since I discovered that your fellow ''Jawas'' were being made ''slaves'' by the Republic, our trades have allowed me to free them.|Dooku, to a disguised Yoda|<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] set up an [[Unidentified Tatooine camp|enslavement camp]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to [[Prison/Legends|incarcerate]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. Consequently, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] deceived a [[Unidentified Jawa clan|Jawa clan]] into believing that their fellow Jawas were being [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This treachery allowed him to buy Republic [[Starship/Legends|ship]] parts from the Jawas, which were used to retrofit [[Warship/Legends|warships]] of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. In exchange, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] promised them that, given time, the Republic would be driven from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and their people would be freed from Republic oppression. As a result of this trade, the Separatists won several battles in the Outer Rim and Republic losses increased dramatically in this region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />

==The mission==
[[File:Mission_to_Tatooine_Yoda_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] duels with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]]]
{{Quote|This battle droid at the camp I ''deactivated''. The Separatists' ''treachery revealed'', it is.|Yoda|<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />}}
Concerned by the fact that the Separatists appeared to be using Republic weapons against their own ships, [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] followed a trail of evidence leading to Tatooine. Suspecting a Jawa clan to be responsible for recovering the debris and selling them to Dooku, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] went on a mission to Tatooine in order to investigate. There, disguised as the Jawa [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] "Nemb" of [[Adoy Clan]], Yoda infiltrated the suspected clan. That night, he found the Separatist camp, which was guarded by at least one [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]], and freed its [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], including [[Fodani]]. The next day, during a visit of Count Dooku on Tatooine, Fodani revealed to his clan that it was actually the Separatist leader who had enslaved the Jawas. Yoda then engaged Dooku in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], while the Jawas helped him by firing their [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blasters]] at the Sith Lord. Seeing that his scheme had failed, Dooku fled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] aboard his [[Count Dooku's solar sailer/Legends|his]] [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]].<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Mission_to_Tatooine_Yoda_3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] befriends the [[Unidentified Jawa chief|Jawa chief]] at the end of the mission]]
{{Quote|To say ''sorry'', and to ''thank'' you for ''freeing'' my people, here are some ''schematics'' of Separatist ''weapons'' and ''ships''. They may be of use to you.''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''Appreciate'' this offer I do. Enable the Republic to ''defend'' our ships in the Outer Rim, these plans will. My ''thanks'' I will give you.|The [[Unidentified Jawa chief|Jawa chief]] and Yoda|<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />}}
Following the event, the Jawas put an end to their trade with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Also, to thank the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] for freeing their people, the Jawas gave him schematics of Separatist weapons and ships, thus enabling the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] to defend its ships in the Outer Rim.<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />
